limitations.quote: `ready_a` stays high, including during reset. On the sixth accepted bit, the module updates `data_b` and pulses `valid_b` for one cycle.
limitations.note: Registering `valid_b` fixed its early assertion, but the rewrite also changed `ready_a` from reset-low to always high and gated the registered terminal-count flag with `valid_a`, unlike the reference.
The test exercised reset and a stall after five bits, but its scoreboard expected the rewrite’s always-high ready and completion-only valid, so passing could not reveal either mismatch.
